changes: Added docs/requirements/decisions/decision-doc-promotion-execution-plan.md as the durable execution plan for future decision-doc promotion, and updated docs/requirements/NAV.md so the new decision doc is discoverable. Recorded Lattice PLAN, REVIEW, TEST, and 3 round x 2 host quorum evidence for the document.
usage: Future implementation stories can use this plan as the contract for adding decision_doc_proposal, decision_doc_preview, and decision_doc_save. For this completed story, run lattice decision_doc_quorum_check --storyId=B-16eb --json to inspect the local decision-doc quorum evidence.
expectedOutcome: B-16eb completes with the decision-doc promotion execution plan in docs/requirements/decisions, NAV linked, decision_doc_quorum_check ok:true, and validate covering all verification intents.
actualTranscript: lattice decision_doc_quorum_check --storyId=B-16eb --json returned ok:true with three valid rounds and two passing hosts per round. lattice validate --story=B-16eb passed npm test fallback and reported verification intent coverage 9/9 covered.
outcomeDiff: No user-visible acceptance gap. Operationally, REVIEW->TEST lint first failed until npm --prefix packages/main run build refreshed ignored packages/main/dist output in the worktree; after that lint and validation passed.
limitations: This story is documentation and Lattice evidence only. It does not implement decision_doc_proposal, decision_doc_preview, decision_doc_save, configurable path policy, Authority receipt semantics, or productionDone semantics.
pitfalls: Two early host verdicts were blocked because those hosts confused single-file sha256 with the canonical decision_doc_quorum_check materialDigest. The blocked rows stayed recorded and were ignored by the quorum checker; corrected hosts used the CLI digest and passed.
